news.title: Katie McCabe on why her move to Chelsea has been a 'breath of fresh air'
news.title_zh: 凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 谈为何转会切尔西让她“呼吸到了新鲜空气”
news.body_en: Katie McCabe says she’s ‘enjoying her football again’ after her summer transfer to Chelsea. The left-back was speaking in her captain’s role for the Republic of Ireland after she scored in a 5-0 win over Kazakhstan on Tuesday, a result that sent her nation through to the second round of the 2027 Women’s World Cup play-offs with a 12-0 aggregate win. While her focus on the night was purely on her country, she gave a glimpse into life at her new club to give some context to her excellent form. ‘The move for me has been a breath of fresh air,’ she said. ‘It was time for me to start a new chapter. Ever since I’ve come in to work with Chelsea and Sonia (Bompastor) and the girls, it’s been brilliant. We’ve had a fantastic start to the season. ‘The role is a little bit different, but I’m loving learning all the new things from a new coach. I’m playing with world-class players, and I’m really enjoying it. ‘I’m enjoying my football again and just taking it game by game. There are so many games, but for me personally, what’s most important now is to be in the best position to qualify for a World Cup.’ McCabe captained Ireland to qualify for their first World Cup in Australia and New Zealand in 2023. The side will now face a two-legged tie against Poland to decide whether or not they will qualify for a second consecutive World Cup this summer in Brazil. Carla Ward's side have already beaten Poland twice in qualifying –  a side with Barcelona’s Ewa Pajor among their squad – but things have not all been plain sailing. February’s 4-0 loss against Slovenia in Women’s Nations League action was compounded by another 1-0 defeat to the same opponent in June, and McCabe doesn’t want the team to take anything for granted. ‘We've put ourselves in a really good position,' continued McCabe. 'The opponents we've faced, top ten opponents, the girls have done brilliantly. Since Carla came in, it's been a transition period, and it’s taken a bit of time to find our feet. ‘We learnt our lesson with that heavy defeat by Slovenia, and we've built and grown. We've tried to gather as much momentum as possible. We've had some highs and lows over the years. It's going to be really important, and we'll stick together going into November. ‘We'll be doing everything we can to get over the line and get this country to the World Cup again. For us, we've played them recently, and it's going to be different come November. We know there's a World Cup place at stake, so we need to be ready. It's an exciting one.’ Don't miss Katie in action against our London derby rivals Spurs at the Bridge this Sunday! Get your tickets here...
news.body_zh: 凯蒂·麦凯布表示，在夏季转会到切尔西后，她“再次享受足球的乐趣”。周二，这位左后卫在爱尔兰共和国5-0战胜哈萨克斯坦的比赛中攻入一球，帮助爱尔兰队以总比分12-0晋级2027年女足世界杯附加赛第二轮。虽然她当晚的注意力完全集中在她的国家，但她也瞥见了新俱乐部的生活，为她出色的状态提供了一些背景。 “这次搬迁对我来说是呼吸新鲜空气，”她说。 “现在是我开始新篇章的时候了。自从我开始与切尔西、索尼娅（邦帕斯特）和女孩们一起工作以来，一切都很棒。我们这个赛季有一个美妙的开局。 “这个角色有点不同，但我喜欢从新教练那里学习所有新东西。我正在和世界级的球员一起比赛，我真的很享受。 “我又开始享受我的足球了，并且一场一场地踢球。比赛有很多，但对我个人来说，现在最重要的是处于获得世界杯参赛资格的最佳位置。麦凯布带领爱尔兰首次获得 2023 年澳大利亚和新西兰世界杯的参赛资格。球队现在将与波兰进行两回合比赛，以决定他们是否能够连续第二次参加今年夏天在巴西举行的世界杯。卡拉·沃德的球队已经在预选赛中两次击败波兰队——巴塞罗那队的埃瓦·帕约尔也在其中——但事情并非一帆风顺。 2 月在女子国家联赛中 0-4 负于斯洛文尼亚，而 6 月又以 1-0 负于同一对手，麦凯布不希望球队认为任何事情都是理所当然的。 “我们已经把自己置于一个非常有利的位置，”麦凯布继续说道。 “我们面对的对手，排名前十的对手，女孩们都表现得很出色。自从卡拉加入以来，这是一个过渡期，我们花了一些时间才能站稳脚跟。 “我们从斯洛文尼亚的惨败中吸取了教训，我们已经建立并成长了。我们试图聚集尽可能多的动力。这些年来我们经历过一些高潮和低谷。这将非常重要，我们将在十一月份团结一致。 “我们将尽一切努力来克服困难，让这个国家再次进入世界杯。对我们来说，我们最近已经打过这些比赛，到了 11 月份情况将会有所不同。我们知道世界杯席位岌岌可危，所以我们需要做好准备。这是一场令人兴奋的比赛。”不要错过本周日在桥上对阵我们的伦敦德比对手热刺队的凯蒂的比赛！在这里获取门票...

news.title: Lexi Potter: My journey to Chelsea
news.title_zh: 莱克西·波特：我的切尔西之旅
news.body_en: On Tuesday night, Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter made her first senior appearance for England, starting in midfield alongside her Blues team-mate Keira Walsh. Handed Legacy Number 244 ahead of kick-off, the 20-year-old then helped the Lionesses to a 5-0 win in the Women's World Cup play-off against Greece at Leicester's King Power Stadium. It was an ideal way for her to begin what looks set to be a long career with England. We spoke to Lexi about her journey to becoming a Chelsea player in March. By the end of that season, she had made four starts and ten substitute appearances, scoring her maiden goal for the Blues in a 2-1 win over Brighton & Hove Albion. This season, our head coach Sonia Bompastor has explained that Potter has now cemented her place in the Blues first team. She has made five starts and two appearances from the bench in our opening nine games of the campaign, a run of form that has made it impossible for England's Sarina Wiegman to ignore. Here is where we began our homegrown star's story back in March... The young midfielder is still relatively new to conducting interviews, but her enthusiasm shines through nonetheless. When the topic of football is introduced, she immediately lights up, and it’s evident she is living out her dream here at Chelsea. ‘Football means everything to me,’ she smiles. ‘It's always been football, football, football. I was never really interested in school. I just wanted to come home, get my kit on and go to training. Ever since I was a young girl, it's been the biggest part of my life.’ Potter was born in Epsom, but has lived in Redhill since the age of three. She described an area that has everything she needs close by, including Chelsea’s Cobham training ground. Her upbringing has provided the platform for her football career to blossom. She beams when she talks about her family and explains how their dedication to her passion from a young age helped her succeed. ‘My dad is from Essex, and my mum is from Banstead,’ she explains. ‘My mum works at a primary school and I went to the same school when I was younger. My dad works from home so he's there a lot with the dog. He's never left alone…the dog, I mean! ‘I've been really lucky with the support that I've had. My mum spent a lot of time taking me to football and my grandparents live quite locally, so my brother would spend time with them when my mum was out taking me places. My family was very supportive and encouraging. ‘My earliest football memory was playing with my brother and his friends in the local boys' football team. Just playing with my brother, having fun. We're close in age, he was the year above me at school, so I wanted to do everything he did. ‘I went to Saint Bede’s School in Redhill. I played for the boys' team there - we didn't really have a girls' team. After school, I played out with my brother.' It’s not only natural talent that has made Potter stand out above other players of the same age. A look at her performances in the first team this season shows she has all the attributes to become an elite midfielder: sharp passing, good decision-making, close control and the physicality to hold off opponents while shielding the ball. The conversation moves on, and it immediately becomes clear how she has managed to develop those attributes at such a young age. Playing futsal on a small indoor pitch against boys opened the door to her becoming one of England’s best young talents in the centre of the park. ‘I played futsal for a long time when I was growing up with my brother,’ explains Potter. ‘It's indoors, so it's quite tight, confined spaces. You had to learn to be good on the ball technically and try to get out of these tight spaces. It was about close control and the importance of the basics. ‘We played together when we were younger, before it became really physical. For me, it was important to play with boys because they can help shape you as a player. You have to move the ball more quickly. ‘You have to react quicker, you have to be smart and know what you want to do with the ball before you get it, because of how quick and agile they can be. You have to make those decisions faster. ‘Boys are a lot more physical and aggressive, so I feel like playing with them has helped me to become the player I am today.’ Having signed for the Chelsea academy at eight years old, Potter has grown up in an environment designed to help keep her feet on the ground – and it shows. Her two-year loan spell at Crystal Palace between 2023 and 2025 allowed her to compete against experienced professionals, and now she is continuing her development in the Chelsea first team. ‘I’ve never really thought to myself that I’m good,’ she says. ‘It’s more a feeling of being humble and wanting to work hard to be the best I can be. But in the Academy, we had a good team, and I had really good players around me. We won the FA Cup together. ‘Being at the Chelsea Academy was so good for me. Some brilliant staff members helped me along the way, and I was surrounded by great players at my age. Then I went on loan to Palace. We won the Women’s Championship, and then I had the opportunity to play in the WSL the following season. ‘It was a bit difficult for me when I first went there, though. It was a women's team, so I had to grow up really quickly from the academy in terms of needing to be independent and stuff. I had been at Chelsea my whole life, but then I had to adapt to a new atmosphere and try to break into an established team. And as footballers, all we want to do is to be playing. ‘All the sacrifices are worth it to be able to play for Chelsea and to be able to play with world-class players here. It’s something you dream of when you are young and hope to be able to do. But I know I've got a long way to go still. ‘I try not to get distracted by others because everyone's journey is different, so I concentrate on myself. I want to keep learning every day, take good advice, give it my all and have no regrets. ‘Now I’m back at Chelsea, training every single day with the first team. I love working in such a high-performance atmosphere and being a part of a squad who are always competing for trophies. It’s amazing to be learning from the best.’
news.body_zh: 周二晚上，切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特首次代表英格兰国家队出场，与她的蓝军队友凯拉·沃尔什一起在中场首发。这位20岁的球员在开球前将球衣号码交给了Legacy 244，随后帮助狮队在莱斯特王权球场举行的女足世界杯附加赛中以5-0战胜希腊队。对于她来说，这是开始在英格兰度过漫长职业生涯的理想方式。我们在三月份采访了莱克西，讲述了她成为切尔西球员的历程。到那个赛季结束时，她已经首发四次，替补出场十次，并在蓝军2-1战胜布莱顿的比赛中打进了她的处子球。本赛季，我们的主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释说，波特现在已经巩固了她在蓝军一线队的地位。在本赛季的前九场比赛中，她首发五次，替补出场两次，这种状态让英格兰队的萨琳娜·维格曼无法忽视。这是我们三月份开始讲述我们本土球星的故事的地方……这位年轻的中场球员在接受采访方面还相对较新，但她的热情仍然闪耀着。当谈到足球这个话题时，她立刻就兴奋起来，很明显她正在切尔西实现自己的梦想。 “足球对我来说意味着一切，”她微笑着说。 “一直都是足球、足球、足球。我对学校从来没有真正的兴趣。我只想回家，穿上我的装备去参加训练。从我还是个小女孩的时候起，这就是我生命中最重要的部分。”波特出生在埃普索姆，但从三岁起就住在红山。她描述了一个附近有她需要的一切的区域，包括切尔西的科巴姆训练场。她的成长经历为她的足球生涯提供了蓬勃发展的平台。当她谈到她的家庭并解释他们从小就对她的热情的奉献如何帮助她取得成功时，她笑容满面。 “我的父亲来自埃塞克斯，我的母亲来自班斯特德，”她解释道。 “我妈妈在一所小学工作，我小时候也上过同一所学校。我爸爸在家工作，所以他经常带着狗。他从来没有孤单过……我是说，那只狗！ “我真的很幸运能得到大家的支持。我妈妈花了很多时间带我去踢足球，而我的祖父母住在当地，所以当我妈妈出去带我去的时候，我哥哥会花时间和他们在一起。我的家人非常支持和鼓励我。 “我最早的足球记忆是与我的兄弟和他的朋友在当地男子足球队踢球。和弟弟一起玩，玩得很开心。我们年龄相近，他在学校比我高一年级，所以我想做他所做的一切。 “我去了红山的圣贝德学校。我在那里为男孩队效力——我们并没有真正的女孩队。放学后，我和弟弟一起出去玩。”让波特在同龄球员中脱颖而出的不仅仅是天赋。从她本赛季在一线队的表现来看，她具备成为一名精英中场球员的所有特质：敏锐的传球、良好的决策、严密的控制以及在护球的同时阻挡对手的身体素质。谈话继续进行，我们很快就明白了她是如何在如此年轻的时候培养出这些品质的。在一个小型室内球场上与男孩们踢五人制足球为她成为英格兰公园中心最优秀的年轻天才之一打开了大门。 “当我和哥哥一起长大时，我玩了很长时间的五人制足球，”波特解释道。 “这是在室内，所以空间非常狭窄。你必须学会​​在技术上擅长控球，并尝试摆脱这些狭窄的空间。这是关于密切控制和基础知识的重要性。 “我们年轻的时候就一起踢球，当时还没有真正开始身体对抗。对我来说，和男孩一起打球很重要，因为他们可以帮助你塑造一名球员。你必须更快地移动球。 “你必须反应更快，你必须聪明，在接球之前就知道你想用球做什么，因为他们的速度和敏捷性非常高。您必须更快地做出这些决定。 “男孩们的身体素质和攻击性都更强，所以我觉得和他们一起踢球帮助我成为了今天的我。”八岁时与切尔西青训学院签约，波特在一个旨在帮助她脚踏实地的环境中长大——这一点也表明了这一点。 2023 年至 2025 年间，她租借到水晶宫两年，这使她能够与经验丰富的专业人士竞争，现在她正在切尔西一线队继续发展。 “我从来没有真正认为自己很好，”她说。 “这更多的是一种谦虚的感觉，以及想要努力做到最好的感觉。但在青训学院，我们有一支优秀的团队，我周围也有非常优秀的球员。我们一起赢得了足总杯。 “在切尔西青训学院对我来说非常好。一路上，一些出色的工作人员为我提供了帮助，在我这个年纪，我周围都是伟大的球员。然后我被租借到皇宫。我们赢得了女子冠军，然后我就有机会在接下来的赛季参加 WSL。 “不过，当我第一次去那里时，这对我来说有点困难。这是一支女子球队，所以我必须在需要独立等方面从学院很快成长起来。我一生都在切尔西，但后来我必须适应新的氛围并尝试融入一支老牌球队。作为足球运动员，我们想做的就是踢球。 “为了能够为切尔西效力并能够在这里与世界级球员一起踢球，所有的牺牲都是值得的。这是你年轻时梦想并希望能够做到的事情。但我知道我还有很长的路要走。 “我尽量不被别人分心，因为每个人的旅程都不同，所以我专注于自己。我想每天继续学习，接受好的建议，全力以赴，不留遗憾。 “现在我回到了切尔西，每天都和一线队一起训练。我喜欢在如此高绩效的氛围中工作，并成为一支总是争夺奖杯的球队的一员。向最优秀的人学习真是太棒了。”

news.title: Chelsea’s 10 oldest Premier League scorers
news.title_zh: 切尔西最年长的 10 位英超进球者
news.body_en: Having found the net twice in our win against Bournemouth, Jordan Henderson became one of the oldest goalscorers in our history. Here we look at the top ten such players to have found the net for Chelsea in the Premier League era. Henderson's brilliant brace was some way for him to announce himself to the Stamford Bridge faithful, and put him in distinguished company in our history. Some of the very greatest to have worn the blue shirt – Frank Lampard, Thiago Silva, Didier Drogba and co – found the net late in their Blues careers, and here we look back at our top ten league goalscorers since 1992... The Rock chose a fantastic moment to score his final goal for us: a header to equalise against Liverpool in May 2003 in a game we had to avoid losing to secure Champions League football – and with it the club’s future. The first of two player-managers on this list, Luca scored in his last game before hanging up his boots. It was a trademark control and volley against Derby County in May 1999. Super Frank’s 211th and final Chelsea goal was a rebound from a penalty saved by future Blue Asmir Begovic as we comfortably defeated Stoke City at Stamford Bridge in April 2014. Henderson marked his Stamford Bridge debut in style, scoring two brilliant long-range goals in our 5-1 win against Bournemouth. Hoddle’s solitary Chelsea goal was a neat touch and finish to put the seal on a 2-0 home win against West Ham United in March 1994. JT’s penultimate game for us yielded his final goal. The opponents at the Bridge in May 2017 were Watford, the goal a well-taken one from inside the six-yard box during a 4-3 victory. In a topsy-turvy London derby against Tottenham in February 1994, Donaghy fired in at the near post to reduce the arrears to 2-1 in a classic we would eventually go on to win 4-3. Gianfranco brought the goalscoring curtain down in Chelsea blue in typically spectacular fashion, cleverly lobbing Everton goalkeeper Richard Wright from close to the touchline. Drogba’s 164th and final goal for us was a smart finish away to Leicester City in April 2015 as we closed in on the Premier League title under Jose Mourinho. Thiago Silva’s perfectly directed header past his compatriot Ederson, of Man City, meant the brilliant Brazilian surpassed Dick Spence as our oldest scorer in November 2023. Spence was 38 years and 282 days old when he scored away to Wolves back on 26 April 1947. There was still time for Thiago to extend that record, with his final Blues goal against Sheffield United in April 2024 coming when he was 39 years and 198 days old. It will take some beating!
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森在我们战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中两次进球，成为我们历史上最年长的进球者之一。下面我们来看看英超时代为切尔西进球的前十名球员。亨德森的精彩梅开二度在某种程度上让他向斯坦福桥的忠实球迷宣告了自己，并让他成为了我们历史上的杰出人物。一些最伟大的蓝色球衣球员——弗兰克·兰帕德、蒂亚戈·席尔瓦、迪迪埃·德罗巴等——在他们的蓝军职业生涯后期都取得了进球，在这里我们回顾一下自 1992 年以来的十大联赛射手……这位巨石选择了一个绝佳的时刻为我们打进了他的最后一个进球：2003 年 5 月对阵利物浦的头球扳平比分，在这场比赛中，我们必须避免失利，以确保欧冠资格，也确保了俱乐部的未来。卢卡是这份名单上的两位球员兼教练中的第一位，他在挂靴前的最后一场比赛中进球。这是 1999 年 5 月对阵德比郡的标志性控球和凌空抽射。2014 年 4 月，我们在斯坦福桥轻松击败斯托克城，超级弗兰克在切尔西的第 211 个也是最后一个进球是从未来的蓝军阿斯米尔·贝戈维奇扑出的点球中反弹。亨德森以风格完成了他在斯坦福桥的处子秀，在我们 5-1 战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中打进了两个精彩的远射进球。 1994 年 3 月，霍德尔在切尔西队的唯一进球是一次漂亮的射门，帮助球队主场 2-0 战胜西汉姆联队。JT 为我们队倒数第二场比赛打进了他的最后一个进球。 2017 年 5 月，蓝桥的对手是沃特福德，进球是在 6 码禁区内漂亮射门，最终以 4-3 获胜。 1994 年 2 月，在一场混乱的伦敦德比战托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中，多纳吉近门柱射门，将落后的比分缩小到 2-1，这场经典比赛最终让我们以 4-3 获胜。身着切尔西蓝球衣的吉安弗兰科以典型的壮观方式拉开了进球帷幕，他巧妙地在边线附近吊射埃弗顿门将理查德·赖特。德罗巴为我们打进的第 164 个进球，也是最后一个进球，是 2015 年 4 月客场对阵莱斯特城的精彩进球，帮助我们在穆里尼奥的带领下锁定了英超冠军。蒂亚戈·席尔瓦完美的头球攻破了他的同胞曼城的埃德森，这意味着这位才华横溢的巴西人在 2023 年 11 月超越了迪克·斯彭斯，成为我们最年长的进球者。1947 年 4 月 26 日客场对阵狼队的比赛中，斯彭斯进球时，他已经 38 岁零 282 天。蒂亚戈还有时间延续这一纪录，2024 年 4 月对阵谢菲尔德联队时，他在蓝军的最后一个进球是在 39 岁的时候完成的。 198天了。这将需要一些打击！

news.title: OTD: John Terry goes in goal!
news.title_zh: OTD：约翰·特里进球了！
news.body_en: It is not often you see an outfielder have to take the goalkeeper gloves but that is exactly what John Terry did at Reading 20 years ago today. Our first league visit to the Madejski Stadium to play the newly-promoted Royals was a frenzied affair from the off. Inside a minute, Petr Cech suffered a serious head injury that threatened his life. Thankfully, after surgery on his skull, the goalkeeper was able to make a full recovery. He was back between our posts just a few months later. Back to Berkshire, and Frank Lampard put us ahead with a deflected free-kick on the stroke of half-time. The battle continued in the second half as both sides were reduced to ten men, before Cudicini - who had replaced Cech early on - was knocked unconscious after being clattered into by Ibrahima Sonko while collecting a corner. With a few minutes still to play, captain Terry took the shirt of third-choice keeper Hilario and headed between the posts as the nine-man Blues saw out a gritty 1-0 win. JT didn't have too much to do, thankfully, but you can see still him in action in this unfamiliar role below.
news.body_zh: 你很少会看到外野手必须接过守门员手套，但这正是约翰·特里20年前的今天在雷丁所做的。我们第一次在联赛中造访马德伊斯基球场，对阵升班马皇家队，从一开始就是一场疯狂的比赛。一分钟之内，切赫头部严重受伤，危及生命。值得庆幸的是，在颅骨手术后，守门员能够完全康复。几个月后，他又回到了我们的岗位。回到伯克郡，弗兰克·兰帕德在半场结束时射出一脚偏出的任意球，帮助我们取得领先。下半场双方的战斗仍在继续，双方都只剩下十人，而早早替换切赫的库迪奇尼在获得角球时被易卜拉希马·松科撞倒昏迷。比赛还剩几分钟时，队长特里接过第三门将希拉里奥的球衣，头球攻门，由九人组成的蓝军以 1-0 险胜。值得庆幸的是，JT 没有太多事情要做，但您仍然可以在下面看到他在这个陌生角色中的表演。

news.title: Moises Caicedo interview: I want to keep improving at ‘my home’ Chelsea
news.title_zh: 莫伊塞斯·凯塞多采访：我想在“我的家”切尔西不断进步
news.body_en: In an exclusive interview with Moises Caicedo, the Ecuadorian reflects on his journey at the Bridge, his bond with Blues supporters, and why he’s hungrier than ever for success… It is a testament to Moises Caicedo’s durability and consistency that his spell on the sidelines at the start of this season was his first absence of any note during his Chelsea career, which began more than three years ago now. That Caicedo never shirks a challenge in the heart of the midfield battle only makes that fact more impressive. He has won possession on more occasions than anyone else in the Premier League since the start of 2023/24, when he arrived at the Bridge, and only two players have made more tackles and interceptions in that time. Now, Caicedo’s back. Against Bournemouth on Saturday, it was like the Ecuadorian had never been away. Within 35 seconds of kick-off, he skilfully collected a bouncing ball, turned away from his man and drew a foul. Then came a forward pass to Cole Palmer, who darted into Bournemouth territory before teeing up Jordan Henderson to open the scoring. The replays of that fabulous strike had barely stopped showing when Caicedo won a tackle on the edge of the Bournemouth box, robbing Ryan Christie. The loose ball was worked to Morgan Rogers, who doubled our lead. Caicedo was withdrawn on 72 minutes – shortly after we had gone 5-1 up – to a standing ovation. No player had won more tackles or had a higher pass completion rate. His performance encapsulated the overwhelmingly positive impact he has had since joining Chelsea. And as he sits down with us at Cobham to reflect on his time at the Bridge so far, Caicedo tells us it has been a period of continuous growth, lessons learned and obstacles hurdled. His nature dictates it cannot stop now. ‘It has been a great journey for me, more than three special years at one of the best clubs in the world,’ Caicedo says. ‘In my first season, I passed some tough moments, I would say. They helped me to grow, to keep developing, and to be in the position I am in right now. I can look back and say it’s a pleasure for what I passed. ‘Now I’m just enjoying trying to do everything for this club, because they gave me everything. They helped me in every way, and I’ve grown up a lot because of them. I have more experience now, I’m more mature, and I just want to keep learning and keep doing what I’m doing. ‘I feel very grateful to Chelsea, and I want to keep showing the fans and everybody at the club what I am capable of.’ On the pitch, Caicedo is always in the thick of the action. No games pass him by, that’s for sure. Away from the grass, though, the 24-year-old is an unassuming character, softly spoken and kind. He prefers to set a good example with the way he plays, although he knows, as a member of the leadership group at Cobham, he has greater responsibility to make himself heard. ‘I think every coach tells me that I can improve talking on the pitch, you know? Because they know that I'm a leader, but it will be better for me if I start talking more with the players. I try my best, but it’s not in my nature. So when I'm not able to talk, I just try to show even more. ‘You learn from the previous ones, like Thiago Silva,’ Moises adds. ‘He was an example for us. He tried to help us in every moment. How he was a leader here was amazing for all of us. Now being one of the captains is a pleasure for me, and a special feeling for my family. Even if I’m not a player who likes to talk a lot, I like to show through what I do, so others can see my example.’ Xabi Alonso has said he has a ‘soft spot’ for our midfielders, because that was his position, and our manager has already described Caicedo as ‘one of the best holding players in the world’. Comments like those serve as motivation, the Ecuadorian explains. ‘With Xabi I am going to keep developing, for sure, and show him why he trusts me.’ There has been plenty of change during Caicedo’s time at the Bridge, but the support he has received from Chelsea fans, at home and abroad, has been a constant. He has observed the Blues’ popularity expand in his native Ecuador, and that relationship was cemented recently when the club completed the renovation of a community football pitch in Guayaquil, a port city in the west of the country. ‘It was a proud moment for me because Chelsea are doing things in Ecuador and I think I opened that door for them to go,’ says Caicedo. ‘The fans in Ecuador and at Stamford Bridge support me so much. Every game I see people from Ecuador in the stadium. And it’s an amazing feeling when the Chelsea fans sing my song. ‘They have been incredible with me. I just want to show them my best every single week because they like going to the game at the weekend and being happy and enjoying it. This is why we work in training every day, because they are on our minds and they deserve good things.’ So, too, does Caicedo. His achievements at Chelsea so far have included collective and individual accolades, but world-class levels of performance merit more, and he says he is feeling confident of winning silverware under Alonso’s guidance. Whatever happens, it has been a wonderful journey up until this point, a journey Caicedo reflects on with pride and renewed purpose. ‘I can say Chelsea is my home, because they treat me like I've been here for a long, long time,’ he smiles. ‘It’s a special place for me. 'I want to always give them happiness because I know they did everything for me. Everybody here, from the kitman to the coach, is a kind person to me. ‘The only thing I can say is that I want to always be the same, but even more so on the pitch. I want to always show my team-mates, the coaches, the fans, just what I'm capable of.’ That is a mantra we have no doubt Caicedo will continue to live by.
news.body_zh: 在接受莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的独家采访时，厄瓜多尔人回顾了他在蓝桥的旅程、他与蓝军球迷的联系，以及为什么他比以往任何时候都更渴望成功……这证明了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的持久性和稳定性，他在本赛季开始时在场边的表现是他在切尔西职业生涯中的第一次缺席，而他的切尔西生涯已经开始了三年多了。凯塞多在中场核心的战斗中从不回避挑战，这只会让这一事实更加令人印象深刻。自2023/24年初抵达蓝桥以来，他在英超联赛中赢得控球的次数比其他任何人都多，而同期只有两名球员的铲球和拦截次数比他多。现在，凯塞多回来了。周六对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，厄瓜多尔人就像​​从未离开过一样。开球后 35 秒内，他巧妙地接住了一个弹跳的球，转身背对防守球员，并造成了犯规。然后，科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 向前传球，后者冲入伯恩茅斯领地，然后为乔丹·亨德森 (Jordan Henderson) 首开纪录。当凯塞多在伯恩茅斯禁区边缘抢断瑞安·克里斯蒂的铲球时，那记精彩进球的重播刚刚停止。摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）将球传给了他，他将我们的领先优势扩大了一倍。凯塞多在第 72 分钟时被撤下——就在我们 5-1 领先之后不久——全场起立鼓掌。没有任何球员赢得更多铲断或传球完成率更高。他的表现体现了他加盟切尔西以来所产生的极其积极的影响。当凯塞多在科巴姆与我们坐下来回顾他迄今为止在蓝桥的时光时，他告诉我们这是一个不断成长、吸取教训和克服障碍的时期。他的本性决定了现在不能停下来。 “这对我来说是一段伟大的旅程，在世界上最好的俱乐部之一度过了三年多的特殊岁月，”凯塞多说。 “我想说，在我的第一个赛季，我经历了一些艰难的时刻。他们帮助我成长，帮助我不断发展，并帮助我达到现在的位置。我可以回顾过去，对我所经历的一切感到高兴。 “现在我很享受为这个俱乐部做一切，因为他们给了我一切。他们在各方面帮助了我，我也因为他们而成长了很多。我现在有了更多的经验，我更加成熟，我只想继续学习，继续做我正在做的事情。 “我非常感谢切尔西，我想继续向球迷和俱乐部的每个人展示我的能力。” 在球场上，凯塞多总是处于最激烈的状态。没有比赛能超越他，这是肯定的。不过，远离草地后，这位 24 岁的年轻人性格谦逊，说话轻声细语，心地善良。他更喜欢用自己的比赛方式树立一个好榜样，尽管他知道，作为科巴姆领导小组的成员，他有更大的责任让自己的声音被听到。 “我想每个教练都告诉我，我可以提高在球场上的演讲能力，你知道吗？因为他们知道我是一名领导者，但如果我开始更多地与球员交谈，这对我来说会更好。我尽力而为，但这不是我的本性。所以当我无法说话时，我只是尝试展示更多。 “你可以向以前的人学习，比如蒂亚戈·席尔瓦，”莫伊塞斯补充道。 “他是我们的榜样。他每时每刻都试图帮助我们。他如何成为这里的领导者对我们所有人来说都是令人惊奇的。现在成为队长之一对我来说是一种荣幸，对我的家人来说也是一种特殊的感觉。即使我不是一个喜欢说话的球员，我也喜欢通过我所做的事情来展示，这样其他人就能看到我的榜样。”哈维·阿隆索曾说过，他对我们的中场球员“情有独钟”，因为那是他的位置，我们的主教练已经将凯塞多描述为“世界上最好的控球球员之一”。厄瓜多尔人解释说，类似的评论可以起到激励作用。 “在哈维的带领下，我肯定会继续进步，并向他展示为什么他信任我。”凯塞多在蓝桥期间发生了很多变化，但他从国内外切尔西球迷那里得到的支持却始终如一。他观察到蓝军在他的祖国厄瓜多尔的受欢迎程度不断扩大，最近俱乐部完成了该国西部港口城市瓜亚基尔社区足球场的翻修工程，这种关系得到了巩固。 “这对我来说是一个值得骄傲的时刻，因为切尔西正在厄瓜多尔做事，我想我为他们打开了大门，”凯塞多说。 “厄瓜多尔和斯坦福桥的球迷非常支持我。每场比赛我都会在体育场里看到来自厄瓜多尔的人。当切尔西球迷唱我的歌时，感觉很奇妙。 “他们对我来说非常棒。我只想每周向他们展示我最好的一面，因为他们喜欢在周末去看比赛，并快乐地享受比赛。这就是为什么我们每天都在训练中，因为我们关心他们，他们应该得到好的东西。”凯塞多也是如此。迄今为止，他在切尔西取得的成就包括集体和个人荣誉，但世界级的表现水平更值得，他说他有信心在阿隆索的指导下赢得奖杯。无论发生什么，到目前为止，这都是一段美妙的旅程，凯塞多带着自豪和新的目标回顾这段旅程。 “我可以说切尔西是我的家，因为他们对待我就像我已经在这里待了很长时间一样，”他微笑着说道。 “这对我来说是一个特别的地方。 “我想永远给他们幸福，因为我知道他们为我做了一切。这里的每个人，从装备工到教练，对我来说都是友善的人。 “我唯一能说的是，我希望永远保持不变，但在球场上更是如此。我想永远向我的队友、教练、球迷展示我的能力。”我们毫不怀疑凯塞多将继续恪守这一口号。

news.title: Internationals: James, Bjorn and McCabe net as Potter debuts
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：波特首秀，詹姆斯、比约恩和麦凯布入网
news.body_en: It was an excellent evening for several Chelsea players on international duty as their hopes of playing at the 2027 Women’s World Cup remained alive. There were victories across the board in European qualifiers for next summer’s tournament in Brazil, with those involved now turning their attention to next month’s second and final round of play-offs. At the King Power Stadium, Lauren James netted two first-half goals and Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter debuted for the Lionesses as England made light work of Greece, winning 5-0 on the night and 8-1 on aggregate. Potter lined up alongside Keira Walsh in the centre of England’s midfield, reprising the partnership that have proven so effective this season. Hannah Hampton started in goal while James was deployed in the no.10 position behind Alessio Russo. It was James who set up Russo to give England an early lead, which our attacker doubled on 16 minutes with a ferocious left-footed strike that rose into the top corner. Georgia Stanway added a third before James bagged her second and England’s fourth, finishing first time from Lauren Hemp’s delivery. It was James’ final contribution of note as she was withdrawn at the interval following a scintillating 45-minute performance. Potter was replaced by Jess Park on the hour having impressed on her big day. Walsh played the full 90 minutes and set up England’s final goal scored by Russo. Sarina Wiegman’s side play Ukraine in round two. Returning to the starting line-up after serving a first-leg suspension, Katie McCabe made an immediate impact for the Republic of Ireland as they wrapped up a commanding 4–0 victory over Kazakhstan. Wearing the captain's armband, McCabe led from the front and capped off an energetic performance by getting on the scoresheet shortly after the break, firing home in the 49th minute to double Ireland's lead. The emphatic 12-0 aggregate win means Ireland comfortably advance to the next round of qualifying, where they will play Poland. Nathalie Bjorn opened the scoring with a deflected effort as Sweden thrashed Lithuania 10-0 in the second leg of their play-off. Bjorn, who captained Sweden, was withdrawn at half-time with her side already 6-0 ahead. They will face Erin Cuthbert’s Scotland in the next round in what promises to be a fascinating contest. Scotland led 2-0 after the first leg against Czech Republic and made sure of progression with a 3-2 victory in Paisley. Cuthbert was introduced at half-time with the Scots trailing 2-1, but she helped her nation come back to win, providing the dangerous cross that set up the winning goal scored by Christy Grimshaw. Livia Peng kept a clean sheet in Switzerland’s 2-0 victory over Israel, which completed a 9-3 aggregate win. The Swiss will meet Austria next. Veerle Buurman played 70 minutes as the Netherlands despatched Hungary 3-0 to win 11-0 on aggregate. Next up for the Netherlands is a two-legged tie against Slovenia. In Florence, Giulia Dragoni was introduced on the hour as Italy drew 1-1 with Belarus, sealing a 3-1 aggregate success. They will meet Finland in the next round. With their place in the 2027 Women's World Cup already secured, Germany played a friendly against Japan on Tuesday. Club team-mates Sjoeke Nusken and Maika Hamano went up against each other as the European side secured a 2-1 victory. Nusken played all 90 minutes of the encounter, in which Germany came from a goal behind, while Hamano was introduced as a 68th-minute substitute. Over in Australia, Ellie Carpenter was an unused substitute as the Matildas romped to a 7-1 friendly win over  Haiti. Meanwhile, Becky Spencer started for Jamaica as they succumbed to a 3-1 friendly defeat to Mexico. On Monday evening, Kadeisha Buchanan played the first half of Canada’s 4-3 friendly defeat to Denmark in Toronto. Before kick-off, Buchanan and her former Chelsea team-mates Ashley Lawrence and Jessie Fleming were honoured for reaching the milestone of 150 appearances for Canada. Buchanan lined up at centre-back for Casey Stoney’s side, who went into the interval 3-1 down and, despite fighting back, were beaten 4-3. It was their final warm-up game before the CONCACAF W Championship, which starts late next month. Finally, Emma Hayes' USA side battled to a hard-earned 2-2 draw against Spain after suffering a 2-0 defeat to the reigning World Champions last Saturday. Alyssa Thompson started the match as La Roja once again found themselves 2-0 up, before a goal from Ashley Sanchez pulled one back for the home side early in the second half. Thompson was switched for her sister Giselle after an hour, and the draw was clinched late on with an 86th-minute volley from Mallory Swanson.
news.body_zh: 对于几名正在执行国家队任务的切尔西球员来说，这是一个美好的夜晚，因为她们参加 2027 年女足世界杯的希望仍然存在。明年夏天在巴西举行的欧洲杯预选赛取得了全面胜利，参赛者现在将注意力转向下个月的第二轮也是最后一轮附加赛。在王权球场，劳伦·詹姆斯上半场梅开二度，切尔西青训学院毕业生莱克西·波特也为母狮队首次亮相，帮助英格兰轻松战胜希腊，当晚以 5-0 获胜，总比分 8-1。波特与凯拉·沃尔什一起出现在英格兰中场的中场，延续了本赛季被证明非常有效的合作关系。汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 首发门将，而詹姆斯则排在阿莱西奥·鲁索 (Alessio Russo) 身后的 10 号位置。正是詹姆斯助攻鲁索让英格兰队早早取得领先，我们的攻击手在第 16 分钟以一记凶猛的左脚射门将球打入球门上角。乔治亚·斯坦威 (Georgia Stanway) 打进第三球，随后詹姆斯获得第二球和英格兰队的第四球，劳伦·汉普 (Lauren Hemp) 首次完成比赛。这是詹姆斯最后一次值得注意的贡献，她在一场精彩的 45 分钟表演后中场休息时退场。杰西·帕克在她的大喜之日给波特留下了深刻的印象，她在这一小时被杰西·帕克取代。沃尔什踢满了90分钟，并助攻鲁索为英格兰队打进最后一球。萨琳娜·维格曼的球队在第二轮对阵乌克兰。凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 在首回合停赛后回到首发阵容，立即为爱尔兰共和国队带来了影响，最终以 4-0 战胜了哈萨克斯坦队。戴着队长袖标的麦凯布在前场领先，中场休息后不久就取得进球，并在第 49 分钟射门得分，将爱尔兰的领先优势扩大一倍，结束了充满活力的表现。总比分 12-0 的大胜意味着爱尔兰轻松晋级下一轮预选赛，他们将对阵波兰。附加赛次回合，纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 射门偏出，瑞典队以 10-0 大胜立陶宛队。瑞典队队长比约恩在半场结束时退场，当时瑞典队已经6-0领先。他们将在下一轮对阵艾琳·卡斯伯特的苏格兰队，这场比赛有望成为一场精彩的比赛。苏格兰首回合2-0领先捷克，并在佩斯利3-2获胜确保晋级。半场结束时，苏格兰队 2-1 落后，库斯伯特上场，但她帮助国家队逆转取胜，她的一记危险传中帮助克里斯蒂·格里姆肖攻入致胜一球。瑞士队2-0战胜以色列队，彭丽媛保持不失球，总比分9-3获胜。瑞士队接下来将迎战奥地利队。维尔勒·布尔曼出战70分钟，荷兰队3-0击败匈牙利队，总比分11-0获胜。荷兰接下来将与斯洛文尼亚进行两回合比赛。在佛罗伦萨，朱利亚·德拉戈尼（Giulia Dragoni）在比赛中登场，意大利队1-1战平白俄罗斯队，最终以总比分3-1获胜。下一轮他们将迎战芬兰队。德国队已经获得了 2027 年女足世界杯的参赛资格，周二他们与日本队进行了一场友谊赛。俱乐部队友 Sjoeke Nusken 和 Maika Hamano 展开对决，欧洲球队以 2-1 获胜。努斯肯打满了这场比赛的90分钟，德国队在落后一球的情况下上场，而滨野在第68分钟替补上场。在澳大利亚，埃莉·卡彭特（Ellie Carpenter）作为替补未上场，帮助玛蒂尔达队以 7-1 战胜海地队。与此同时，贝基·斯宾塞 (Becky Spencer) 为牙买加首发，他们在友谊赛中以 3-1 输给了墨西哥。周一晚上，卡黛莎·布坎南在多伦多举行的加拿大4-3负于丹麦的友谊赛中踢了上半场比赛。开赛前，布坎南和她的前切尔西队友阿什利·劳伦斯和杰西·弗莱明因为加拿大队出场 150 场而获得荣誉。布坎南在凯西·斯托尼的球队中担任中后卫，球队进入中场休息时以1-3落后，尽管进行了反击，但还是以4-3被击败。这是他们在下个月底开始的中北美洲及加勒比海女子锦标赛之前的最后一场热身赛。最终，艾玛·海耶斯的美国队在上周六以 2-0 输给卫冕世界冠军西班牙队后，艰难地以 2-2 战平西班牙队。 艾莉莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 首发出场，西班牙队再次以 2-0 领先，下半场早些时候，阿什利·桑切斯 (Ashley Sanchez) 的进球为主队扳回一球。一个小时后，汤普森被换成了她的妹妹吉赛尔，马洛里·斯旺森在第 86 分钟的抽射最终锁定了平局。

I Am Estevao charts the unique journey of Estevao Willian from the city of Franca in south-east Brazil, through the Santos and Palmeiras youth systems, to arriving in London and that incredible goal against Barcelona. There is exclusive input from Estevao’s family and early coaches, who describe the boy who would become the man we see in Blue today, as well as from Chelsea legends such as Thiago Silva and David Luiz. Estevao also provides an insight into why he chose Chelsea, playing against his future employees at the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup and what Cole Palmer said to him after that game. news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen earned a crucial 2-0 victory over Reading in the EFL Trophy, with Chizaram Ezenwata's brace enough to earn all three points in our final group stage match. Ezenwata broke the deadlock in the 21st minute when he was in the right place at the right time to capitilise on Jack Stevens’ spill. He made it two just a few minutes later with a cultured finish in front of the away supporters. CNG held their own against senior opposition Reading, defending in solid fashion when needed before launching attacks of their own. We chased a third in the second half, but in the end our early goals were enough to secure the win. Chelsea managed to settle into the game after absorbing Reading’s attacking waves in the initial phases. After 21 minutes, the Blues were rewarded for their patience with a first goal of the evening. Harrison Bettoni picked up the ball out on the right and darted towards goal. He beat his defender before unleashing a powerful strike which was subsequently spilled by Reading goalkeeper Stevens. The ball fell at Ezenwata’s feet, and the CNG striker made no mistake from close range. Ezenwata doubled his tally and our advantage only four minutes later. Leo Black marked his EFL Trophy debut for Chelsea with an assist, as he dispossessed Conor Masterson before playing a pass into Ezenwata. The 18-year-old buried his strike through the legs of Stevens to make it 2-0. Ezenwata could have had a first-half hat-trick had it not been for the offside flag, after he dinked the ball over Stevens and into the back of the net. While there was plenty to be pleased with in attack for Chelsea, goalkeeper Freddy Bernal made some top stops both before and after we took the lead. Reading’s early chances didn’t really trouble Bernal, but he met their strong efforts equally as assured. The pick of the bunch came in the 36th minute when Daniel Kyerewaa’s thunderous strike seemed destined for the bottom-left corner. Bernal got across well and turned the shot away, before meeting the consequent corner first and palming the ball away from danger. Bettoni came close to extending our lead even further on a number of occasions. Sol Gordon’s cross towards the back post found the Chelsea forward, whose shot was just wide. He had another effort denied by Stevens, earning a corner. Bettoni created some good chances for his team-mates too, in particular Black. The 19-year-old played the ball into Black’s path, allowing him to strike the ball first time and forcing the goalkeeper into an unorthodox save with his feet. Bettoni was unable to get his name on the scoresheet but Ezenwata’s first-half contributions were enough to send Chelsea back home with our first win in the EFL Trophy this season. The result means Chelsea finish the group stage with five points, putting us in second place in Group F. We will await other results to confirm our progression to the next round. Cobham Next Gen return to league action on Friday 16 October, when we face Stoke City at Clayton Wood Training Ground. The fixture kicks off at 7pm and can be watched live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 科巴姆下一代队在 EFL 奖杯赛中以 2-0 击败雷丁队，凭借奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔的梅开二度，在小组赛最后一场比赛中全取三分。 Ezenwata 在第 21 分钟打破了僵局，他在正确的时间出现在正确的位置，利用了杰克·史蒂文斯的突破。几分钟后，他在客场球迷面前以一记优雅的射门将比分扳平。 CNG在对阵高级对手雷丁的比赛中坚守住了自己的阵地，在需要时进行了稳健的防守，然后再发起自己的进攻。我们在下半场追赶了第三名，但最终我们早早的进球足以确保胜利。切尔西在最初阶段吸收了雷丁的进攻浪潮后成功地融入了比赛。 21分钟后，蓝军的耐心得到了回报，攻入了当晚的第一个进球。哈里森·贝托尼从右侧接球，冲向球门。他击败了防守队员，然后发动了一次强力射门，随后被雷丁门将史蒂文斯挡出。球落在了Ezenwata的脚下，CNG前锋近距离没有失误。仅仅四分钟后，Ezenwata 的得分就翻了一番，我们的优势也增加了一倍。利奥·布莱克 (Leo Black) 在将球传给埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata) 之前，将康纳·马斯特森 (Conor Masterson) 断球，并送出助攻，标志着他在切尔西队的联赛首秀。这位18岁的球员的射门穿过史蒂文斯的腿，将比分改写为2-0。如果不是越位旗子，埃森瓦塔本可以在上半场上演帽子戏法，当时他将球越过了史蒂文斯并入网。虽然切尔西的进攻有很多值得高兴的地方，但门将弗雷迪·伯纳尔在我们取得领先之前和之后都做出了一些顶球扑救。雷丁早期的机会并没有真正困扰伯纳尔，但他同样确信无疑地迎接了他们的大力进攻。第 36 分钟，丹尼尔·凯雷瓦 (Daniel Kyerewaa) 的雷霆般的射门似乎命中了左下角，成为了这群人中的佼佼者。伯纳尔很好地传球，将射门挡开，然后首先接到下一个角球，并将球从危险中扑出。贝托尼多次差点扩大我们的领先优势。索尔·戈登的传中找到了切尔西前锋，后者的射门稍稍偏出。他的另一次射门被史蒂文斯挡出，获得角球。贝托尼也为队友创造了一些好机会，尤其是布莱克。这位 19 岁的球员将球传到布莱克的路径上，让他第一次射门，并迫使守门员用脚进行了非正统的扑救。贝托尼未能在进球表上留下自己的名字，但埃森瓦塔上半场的贡献足以让切尔西带着本赛季在联赛杯中的首场胜利回到主场。这个结果意味着切尔西以 5 分结束小组赛，使我们在 F 组中排名第二。我们将等待其他结果来确认我们是否晋级下一轮。科巴姆下一代将于 10 月 16 日星期五重返联赛，届时我们将在克莱顿伍德训练场迎战斯托克城。比赛将于晚上 7 点开始，订阅 CFC+ 即可观看直播。切尔西：50。弗雷迪·伯纳尔； 56.阿尔菲·奥斯本，48.贾斯汀·奥萨吉，37.奥鲁塔约·苏布洛耶（中）； 31.雷吉·沃森，51.利奥·布莱克，46.肯德利·佩兹（32.马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利），47.哈里森·麦克马洪； 52. 哈里森·贝托尼、62. 奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、55. 索尔·戈登未上场替补：60. 托比·贝尔、61. 马蒂斯·埃布、66. 易卜拉欣·拉巴伊、69. 丹特·维特、74. 赫泽·格里姆韦德、85. 基安 最佳得分手：埃森瓦塔 21、25 黄牌：贝托尼 79、沃顿 91，麦克马洪 91 雷丁：25。杰克·斯蒂芬斯； 39. news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：雷丁0-3切尔西
news.body_en: Eden Perez, Isaac McGillvary and Eliah Semakula were all on target as Chelsea secured a 3-0 away win over Reading in the Under-18s Premier League South. Perez tucked the ball past Franky Rose just after the half-hour mark to break the deadlock; the schoolboy has now netted in back-to-back league matches after scoring in our 5-0 win over Bournemouth before the international break. The Blues found plenty of success down the right wing in the opening period, with Riley Ebho and Ibrahim Rabbaj doubling up on the Reading full-back effectively. Yet it wasn't until the second period that we added to our lead. McGillvary was a constant thorn in the Royals' side and doubled our advantage three minutes after the restart. We were reduced to ten men when Gabriel Sambou was dismissed, but the Blues showed our resilience by standing firm in defence and then adding to our advantage, with Eliah Semakula scoring late on to seal an impressive win. The Blues dominated the first half, creating several good opportunities and not allowing Reading to string a collection of passes together. Our biggest threat came down the right flank, where Ebho caused lots of problems on the overlap. He had our first attempt of the afternoon: a firm effort down the throat of Reading goalkeeper Franky Rose, who pushed the ball behind for a corner. The 17-year-old continued to threaten in advanced areas. One give-and-go with Rabbaj led to Andrew Pennie coming close, as his sweeping shot went just wide of the far post. Against the run of play, Reading’s Aiden Smith struck the crossbar after cutting inside, but it felt only a matter of time before we broke the deadlock. And in the 32nd minute, the goal arrived. McGillvary collected the ball on the left wing and played a pass inside to Perez. He produced a first-time finish into the bottom corner to score his fourth goal of the campaign and put us ahead. We then had a flurry of chances to double our lead, with Rabbaj hitting the post after beating two defenders with his quick feet. McGillvary doubled our lead quickly after the restart. Taking control of the ball on the left flank, he cut inside before being forced to turn his back to goal. Yet he spun away from a challenge and dispatched a left-footed shot beyond Rose and into the bottom corner. Reading hit the crossbar once again in the second half, this time through a Christian Cary free-kick, which came after Sambou was shown a straight red card. Being a man down, the Blues had to showcase our defensive abilities for the first time in the contest. We held off the hosts and managed to come away with a clean sheet, as well as a third goal via Semakula. Perez appeared set for his second of the afternoon but had the ball snatched from his feet by Rose. However, Semakula followed up to finish the attack with a goal and round off our victory. This victory means Chelsea remain second in the Under-18 Premier League on 15 points after seven matches. We trail the league leaders by just one point. news.title: Opening accounts: Henderson joins list of Stamford Bridge debut scorers
news.title_zh: 开户：亨德森加入斯坦福桥首秀得分手名单
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson immediately endeared himself to the Stamford Bridge faithful when he became the latest player to score on his Premier League home debut for the Blues. Henderson wasted little time announcing himself in SW6, bending a wonderful strike in off the post to give us the lead against Bournemouth with not even two minutes on the clock. The midfielder then set up Morgan Rogers' goal that instantly followed, before curling a textbook free-kick into the net during the second half to round off our emphatic 5-1 victory. The 36-year-old joined an impressive list of players who have scored in their first Chelsea league game at the Bridge. Henderson is the 26th to do so in the Premier League era, the third to score a brace (after Mario Stanic and Gonzalo Higuain), and the first since 2023. On that occasion Axel Disasi opened his Blues account to draw us level against Liverpool on the opening day of the campaign - the sixth consecutive season in which a Chelsea player achieved that feat. A season earlier, fellow defender Kalidou Koulibaly notched on his home debut as we drew 2-2 with Tottenham, while Academy product Trevoh Chalobah marked his Premier League bow against Crystal Palace in 2021/22 with a memorable long-range stunner in the second half that sealed a 3-0 victory. Palace were also our opponents in 2020/21 when Ben Chilwell made his Chelsea league debut after sitting out our first three games of the campaign with an injury. The left-back made up for lost time, breaking the deadlock by slamming in a loose ball from close range early in the second half, before crossing for Kurt Zouma to head home our second in an emphatic 4-0 win.A year earlier, it was Mason Mount who delighted the home fans when he found the net against Leicester City just seven minutes into his first senior appearance at the Bridge. Mount, who like Chalobah, was an Academy product, caught Wilfred Ndidi in possession on the edge of the box and slotted the ball past Kasper Schmeichel before celebrating in front of the Shed End. While Higuain never quite found his best form during his loan spell with the Blues in the second half of the 2018/19 season, the Argentinian enjoyed his home league debut as he netted two stunning goals against Huddersfield Town. After opening the scoring against the Terriers with a fine finish at the near post following an excellent through ball by N’Golo Kante, Higuain netted our fourth after the interval with a sensational right-footed effort from 25 yards as we ran out 5-0 winners. The recent trend began in 2017/18 when Alvaro Morata came off the bench to score against Burnley in our season opener. It proved to be a disappointing day as we lost 3-2 after being reduced to ten men for much of the game, but Morata made his mark when he glanced in a Willian cross 11 minutes after he had replaced Michy Batshuayi. Several other players have made a quick impression on Chelsea fans by netting on their home league debuts for the Blues in the Premier League era. In 2014/15, Diego Costa got off the mark at the Bridge by opening the scoring in our 2-0 win over Leicester as he plundered nine goals in his first seven Premier League matches. Loic Remy wasn’t nearly as prolific as the Brazilian, but the French striker found the net eight minutes after coming on as a substitute in our 4-2 win over Swansea in September 2014. And two-time Chelsea Player of the Year Juan Mata also scored after making his debut as a substitute when he sealed a 3-1 win over Norwich City in August 2011. Other players who have scored for the Blues on their league debuts at the Bridge since the turn of the millennium include George Weah (Tottenham Hotspur, January 2000), Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink, Stanic (both against West Ham, August 2000), Boudewijn Zenden (Newcastle 2001), Adrian Mutu (Leicester, August 2003), Claudio Pizarro, Florent Malouda (both against Birmingham City, August 2007) and Deco (Portsmouth, August 2008). news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森成为最新一位在蓝军英超主场首秀中进球的球员，立即赢得了斯坦福桥球迷的喜爱。亨德森很快就在 SW6 中展现了自己的实力，在比赛还剩不到两分钟的时候，他就在门柱外射出一记精彩的射门，帮助我们在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中取得了领先。这位中场球员随后助攻摩根·罗杰斯攻入一球，并在下半场将一记教科书般的任意球入网，最终我们以 5-1 取得了胜利。这位 36 岁的球员加入了在蓝桥的首场切尔西联赛中进球的球员名单，令人印象深刻。亨德森是英超时代第 26 位取得梅开二度的球员，也是第三位梅开二度的球员（仅次于马里奥·斯坦尼奇和冈萨洛·伊瓜因），也是自 2023 年以来的第一位。当时，阿克塞尔·迪萨西在赛季首日开启了他的蓝军账户，帮助我们在对阵利物浦的比赛中扳平比分——这是切尔西球员连续第六个赛季实现这一壮举。一个赛季前，后卫卡利杜·库利巴利在我们2-2战平热刺的比赛中完成了他的主场首秀，而青训球员特雷沃·查洛巴则在2021/22赛季对阵水晶宫的英超联赛中在下半场以一记令人难忘的远射，帮助球队以3-0获胜，标志着他在英超联赛中的首秀。水晶宫也是我们 2020/21 Kante）的精彩直塞球在近门柱处精彩射门首开纪录，伊瓜因在中场休息后以 25 码外的一记精彩右脚射门攻入我们的第四个进球，最终我们以 5-0 获胜。最近的趋势始于2017/18赛季，当时阿尔瓦罗·莫拉塔在赛季揭幕战对阵伯恩利的比赛中替补出场并进球。事实证明这是令人失望的一天，我们在比赛的大部分时间里都只剩下十人，最终以 3-2 落败，但莫拉塔在替换米奇·巴舒亚伊后 11 news.title: Inside the life of Wieke Kaptein
news.title_zh: Wieke Kaptein 的生活内部
news.body_en: Wieke Kaptein fills us in on her footballing journey and how she likes to spend her time behind the scenes. Could you start by telling us where you grew up and what it was like? I grew up in the east of Holland. And it's lovely. It's not really a city; there are a lot of farms. I was always outside. What age did you start playing football? What was the name of your first grassroots team? Achilles 12.That was my beginner's club. It was really lovely because I always played with the boys. Then I went to FC Twente. Who has been the biggest influence on your football career to date? What's been your career highlight to date? Playing at the World Cup in 2023 when I was 17. Who are your best friends in football? Marisa Olislagers, Fieke Kroese, and Aggie Beever-Jones. Could you name your top three favourite players of all time? Pedri, Frenkie de Jong, and I really like Fermin (Lopez) right now. What do you like to do away from football? How do you switch off? I love to walk with my dog, of course - drink coffee with friends. But I try to do something to help other people, try to set something up. So that's very nice. It's a nonprofit, and we're just figuring it out right now and building up. Are you watching any TV series currently?Young Sherlock Holmes. It's really good. I watched it with a friend of mine. If we looked at your Spotify playlist, who's dominating your most-played artists of the year?I love Spanish music. Kapo, Bad Bunny, things like that. What are your top three holiday destinations, either that you’ve been to or want to visit?I would love to go with my brothers to Africa. But of the places I've been... Australia, and I really like Switzerland. If you had guests over for dinner, what would you cook for them?Sweet potatoes with meat and all the vegetables. Can you tell the fans something they might not know about you?Probably, but I can't tell them... What's the best piece of advice you've ever received?Keep both feet on the ground no matter what happens, and always help other people. Finally, what does football mean to you?
news.body_zh: Wieke Kaptein 向我们讲述了她的足球之旅以及她喜欢在幕后度过的时光。您能首先告诉我们您在哪里长大以及是什么样的吗？我在荷兰东部长大。这很可爱。它并不是真正的城市；它是一座城市。有很多农场。我总是在外面。您几岁开始踢足球？你的第一个草根团队叫什么名字？阿喀琉斯 12.那是我的初学者俱乐部。这真的很可爱，因为我总是和男孩们一起玩。然后我去了特温特足球俱乐部。迄今为止，谁对您的足球生涯影响最大？迄今为止，您的职业生涯亮点是什么？当我 17 岁的时候参加 2023 年世界杯。谁是你在足球界最好的朋友？玛丽莎·奥利斯拉格斯、菲克·克罗斯和阿吉·比弗-琼斯。你能说出你最喜欢的三名球员吗？佩德里、弗兰基·德容和我现在真的很喜欢费明（洛佩兹）。足球之外你喜欢做什么？你如何关闭？当然，我喜欢和我的狗一起散步——和朋友一起喝咖啡。但我尝试做一些事情来帮助其他人，尝试做一些事情。所以这非常好。这是一个非营利组织，我们现在正在解决这个问题并不断发展。你现在在看什么电视剧吗？《少年夏洛克·福尔摩斯》。真的很好。我和我的一个朋友一起看了。如果我们查看您的 Spotify 播放列表，谁在您年度播放次数最多的艺术家中占据主导地位？我喜欢西班牙音乐。卡波、坏兔子等等。您去过或最想去的三个度假胜地是什么？我很想和我的兄弟们一起去非洲。但在我去过的地方中……澳大利亚，我真的很喜欢瑞士。如果你有客人来吃晚饭，你会为他们做什么？红薯加肉和所有蔬菜。你能告诉粉丝一些他们可能不知道的关于你的事情吗？可能，但我不能告诉他们...你收到过的最好的建议是什么？无论发生什么，都要脚踏实地，永远帮助别人。最后，足球对你来说意味着什么？

news.title: Morgan Rogers on starting fast and which Chelsea player is a 'machine'
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯谈起步快以及哪位切尔西球员是“机器”
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers has given credit to Xabi Alonso for the way Chelsea have come flying out of the blocks in matches this season and explained why he believes Jordan Henderson’s impressive home debut is just the beginning of what the midfielder can do for the Blues. Rogers found the net against Bournemouth on Saturday to put us 2-0 up in just the third minute of the game, as we raced into the lead on our way to a 5-1 victory over the Cherries at Stamford Bridge. It was the fastest that Chelsea have ever taken a two-goal lead in the Premier League - and it was no fluke. We have scored the opening goal inside the first seven minutes in five our of six league games so far this season, with five goals scored inside the first four minutes of matches alone. However, even among that trend, Bournemouth was something special, as Henderson gave us the lead with just one minute played and then teed up Rogers to got a second almost immediately from the restart. ‘It was a bit mad,’ reflected Rogers. ‘I think we were on the front foot straight away and that's what you’ve got to be, especially at home. You’ve got to get the crowd behind you. ‘It was against a really good team. They're playing really well and really good football at the moment, and we knew it was going to be tough. ‘To start like that, it gives you such an advantage moving forward into the game and that kind of set us off and got the precedent rolling. That's all you can ask for really. ‘I put it down to the manager's team talks before. He gets us firing, gets us going. But we always want to start off on the front foot. ‘It's about starting the game well and getting the lead, and that's been a lot of the games, especially at home, that we've kind of jumped on the back of scoring early goals. So it's a good trait to have and we need to keep it going.’ Henderson was making his first appearance for the Blues at the Bridge since joining in the summer and marked the occasion in style, with a fine opening goal followed by the assist for Rogers and then an unstoppable free-kick to complete the scoring. Not that the veteran midfielder’s starring role came as a surprise for his team-mates. ‘People said he was too old and you see what he does,’ Rogers continued. ‘Everyone in the dressing room knows that he's probably still the fittest player at the club, to be honest. He's a machine. ‘People forget about the football because they just think he's that experienced head, but don't get me wrong, the guy can still play football. He's won everything in the game. You saw his quality there and we'll see it for the rest of the season, I'm sure. ‘Hopefully we’ll see more goals from him. He's got the ability, super quality. That's why he's on the free-kick, because he's got that ability to score from distance, and he did it twice on Saturday.’ That praise comes despite Rogers missing out on free-kick duty to Henderson over the international break, with the 24-year-old laughing as he explained: ‘It was a work thing last week before I was there actually. They did it behind my back and then when I've got back I'm off free-kicks all of a sudden! Which I wasn't the best happy about, but as long as we score, that's the most important thing.’ The victory over Bournemouth takes Chelsea up to sixth place in the Premier League table, only outside of the top four on goal difference. However, Rogers echoed the sentiment shared by Alonso that it is still too early in the season to be drawing conclusions on how the campaign will take shape, with the Blues just approaching things one game at a time. ‘As the manager said, and he's been saying all week, which is a good one which I'm going to use now: “We can finish bottom or we can finish first”. There's not been enough games to determine where we can finish and what we can do, and that's how we're taking it. ‘We want to improve ourselves and look at ourselves, which we will do, but we're not looking up and not looking down. We're just looking at ourselves, at how we can improve and get better, and there's a massive improvement already from the international break and having time off and players working. ‘We're working with the manager and trying to improve, so it's been really good, and we've just got to keep moving forward and stay focused.’
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯对哈维·阿隆索在本赛季切尔西在比赛中的表现表示赞赏，并解释了为什么他相信乔丹·亨德森令人印象深刻的主场首秀只是这位中场球员为蓝军所做的事情的开始。周六对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，罗杰斯的进球让我们在比赛第 3 分钟就以 2-0 领先，随后我们在斯坦福桥以 5-1 战胜樱桃队，取得了领先。这是切尔西在英超联赛中以两球领先的最快速度——而且这绝非侥幸。本赛季迄今为止的六场联赛中，我们有五场在前七分钟内就取得了首个进球，仅在比赛的前四分钟内就有五个进球。然而，即使在这种趋势中，伯恩茅斯也很特别，因为亨德森在比赛仅一分钟时就为我们带来了领先，然后在比赛重新开始后几乎立即为罗杰斯提供了第二个机会。 “这有点疯狂，”罗杰斯反映道。 “我认为我们立刻就处于领先地位，这就是你必须做到的，尤其是在主场。你必须让人群支持你。 ‘这是对阵一支非常优秀的球队。他们现在踢得非常好，足球非常好，我们知道这会很艰难。 “以这样的方式开始，它会给你在比赛中提供如此大的优势，这让我们开始并开创了先例。”这就是你真正能要求的。 “我把这归因于之前主帅团队的谈话。他让我们开火，让我们前进。但我们总是想先下手为强。 “关键在于开局良好并取得领先，在很多比赛中，尤其是在主场，我们都在早早进球的基础上取得了进展。这是亨德森自夏天加盟以来首次代表蓝军在蓝桥出场，他以漂亮的开场进球、助攻罗杰斯和一记势不可挡的任意球完成了进球。这位经验丰富的中场球员的主角角色并不让他的队友们感到意外。 “人们说他太老了，你看看他做了什么，”罗杰斯继续说道。 “说实话，更衣室里的每个人都知道他可能仍然是俱乐部里最健康的球员。他是一台机器。 “人们忘记了足球，因为他们只是认为他是一个经验丰富的头脑，但不要误会我的意思，这家伙仍然可以踢足球。他赢得了比赛中的一切。你在那里看到了他的品质，我相信我们会在本赛季剩余的比赛中看到它。 `希望我们能看到他更多的进球。他有能力，品质超群。这就是为什么他能主罚任意球，因为他有远距离得分的能力，而且他在周六就完成了两次。”尽管罗杰斯在国际比赛日期间错过了对亨德森的任意球，但这位24岁的球员笑着解释说：“上周在我真正到那里之前，这是一件工作事情。”他们在我背后这么做了，然后当我回来时，我突然就失去了任意球！我对此并不是最高兴的，但只要我们进球，那就是最重要的。”战胜伯恩茅斯后，切尔西在英超积分榜上上升到第六位，仅因净胜球差距而排在前四名之外。然而，罗杰斯回应了阿隆索的观点，即现在就赛季将如何进行下结论还为时过早，蓝军只是一场一场地进行比赛。 `正如主教练所说，他整个星期都在说，这是一个很好的说法，我现在要使用：“我们可以排名垫底，也可以排名第一”。还没有足够多的比赛来决定我们能在哪里完成以及我们能做什么，这就是我们的应对方式。 “我们想要提高自己，审视自己，我们会这么做，但我们不会向上看，也不会向下看。我们只是关注自己，关注如何改进并变得更好，从国际比赛日、休息时间和球员工作中已经取得了巨大的进步。 “我们正在与主教练合作并努力改进，所以这真的很好，我们必须继续前进并保持专注。”

news.title: Joao Pedro on benefits of the break, bonds and ‘brilliant’ Jordan Henderson
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 谈分手的好处、纽带和“才华横溢”的乔丹·亨德森 (Jordan Henderson)
news.body_en: Joao Pedro was back in the Chelsea team and back among the goals in Saturday’s big win over Bournemouth, with the Brazilian continuing his impressive start to the campaign. Injury ruled the striker out of our defeat at Brentford before the international break, and then stopped Joao Pedro linking up with the Selecao. While it was a frustrating period for our number nine, the pause allowed him to fully recover ahead of the Cherries’ visit. He duly responded with two typically well-taken second-half goals, taking his Premier League tally this season to five. ‘It was a brilliant game,’ said Joao Pedro. ‘The international break was a long time. We had time to work, to fix the mistakes against Brentford, and we got a great result. ‘Of course, you want to win with a clean sheet, so we need to keep working. Hopefully the next game we can get that, but it was a great game and three more points.’ Our front three once again looked potent, with Cole Palmer registering an assist and Morgan Rogers scoring as we continued our happy knack of finding the net early. Joao Pedro is clearly enjoying playing alongside that duo, and he offered some insight into why our attack are working so well in tandem. ‘We work hard. We try to know each other more every day and try to improve, so that's why we can show our quality in the game. ‘When you play close together, you can decide the game, and we showed that again. For me, I just try to be healthy and help my team-mates, and then we'll see what I can achieve.’ It helps when others chip in with goals and that was very much the case on Saturday, with Stamford Bridge debutant Jordan Henderson spectacularly finding the net in each half. The 36-year-old’s performance came as no surprise to Joao Pedro, who has observed what the midfielder offers this Blues group. ‘He is a brilliant player, he has had a lot of years in the Premier League and he is experienced. That’s why he joined us, to help us, and he showed he’s a top, top player. ‘He brings experience, he helps everyone, us in front, the guys at the back, he is a special player and he showed his qualities.’
news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗重返切尔西队，并在周六大胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中打进进球，巴西人继续着他本赛季令人印象深刻的开局。伤病使得这位前锋无法在国际比赛日之前输给布伦特福德，然后让若奥·佩德罗无法与桑巴军团联系。虽然这对我们的九号球员来说是一段令人沮丧的时期，但这次暂停让他在樱桃队来访之前完全康复。他在下半场以两个典型的精彩进球做出了回应，使他本赛季的英超进球数达到了五个。 “这是一场精彩的比赛，”若昂·佩德罗说道。 “国际比赛日的休息时间很长。我们有时间努力，纠正对阵布伦特福德的错误，我们取得了很好的结果。 “当然，你想以零失球的方式获胜，所以我们需要继续努力。希望下一场比赛我们能做到这一点，但这是一场精彩的比赛，还能再拿三分。”我们的前三名球员再次展现出强大的实力，科尔·帕尔默送出助攻，摩根·罗杰斯得分，我们继续早早进球的快乐秘诀。若昂·佩德罗显然很享受与这对搭档并肩作战，他提供了一些见解，解释了为什么我们的进攻如此协调一致。 ‘我们努力工作。我们每天都在努力更多地了解彼此并努力提高，这就是为什么我们可以在比赛中展示我们的实力。 “当你们踢得紧密时，你们就能决定比赛，我们再次证明了这一点。对我来说，我只是努力保持健康并帮助我的队友，然后我们就会看到我能取得什么成就。”当其他人贡献进球时，这会有所帮助，周六的情况就是如此，斯坦福桥首次亮相的乔丹·亨德森在每个半场都精彩地进球。若昂·佩德罗观察到了这位36岁中场球员为蓝军带来的贡献，他对这位36岁球员的表现并不感到意外。 “他是一名出色的球员，在英超联赛中效力多年，经验丰富。这就是他加入我们、帮助我们的原因，他证明了自己是一名顶级球员。 “他带来了经验，他帮助了每个人，包括我们前面的球员，后面的球员，他是一名特殊的球员，他展示了自己的品质。”

news.title: Cole Palmer determined to repay Chelsea’s trust after new contract
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默决心在新合同后回报切尔西的信任
news.body_en: Cole Palmer was pleased to return from the international break with a victory as he focuses on repaying the faith shown in him by Chelsea with his performances on the pitch after putting pen to paper on a new long-term contract. The forward signed a new deal committing his future to the Blues until at least 2034 on Saturday, before taking to the Stamford Bridge pitch as part of Xabi Alonso’s starting line-up to face Bournemouth in our first game since the international break. Palmer and his fellow Blues wasted no time getting back into the swing of things, our No10 setting up Jordan Henderson to open the scoring in the second minute, before Morgan Rogers put us two up straight from the restart. A Joao Pedro brace and a second from Henderson arrived in the second half to give us an emphatic 5-1 victory over the Cherries in our first home game for nearly a month. ‘It was a great win against a good side,’ said Palmer. ‘We knew it'd be difficult, but we played well. ‘It was a good day, especially having key players back. Having nearly the whole squad back, it was good, and I feel like this was a good start to the next games that we have.’ Palmer also had a hand in Henderson’s second goal, his surging run drawing a foul before providing the decoy run as the veteran midfielder curled a pinpoint free-kick into the top corner, a move he reveals was straight off the training ground. ‘We've just been working on it in training and when it came to it, we were thinking about what to do,’ Cole revealed. ‘But I just said to him: “We've worked on it”. He's done it well in training, so before his shot, I said: “Which corner flag are we running to when you put it in the top corner?". ‘And then we chose a corner flag, then he put it in the top corner, then we ran there. So it was funny. It was a good goal and a good day.’ A 5-1 victory felt like the perfect way to celebrate Palmer’s new contract, announced earlier in the day, with the 24-year-old eager to continue showing Chelsea’s faith in him is well placed. ‘It feels nice,’ said Palmer, when asked about signing the contract. ‘Just thank you to the club for trusting me and I've got to keep repaying them. ‘I just work hard and try to give my best, that's all. I feel back to how I was and it's only early in the season, so just keep going. ‘It's still early with the manager and he's still trying to get his ideas across, but we're starting to adapt and especially this week we've been working on ideas and stuff like that, so it's been good.’
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默很高兴在国际比赛日结束后带着一场胜利归来，在签下一份新的长期合同后，他将专注于用自己在球场上的表现来回报切尔西对他的信任。周六，这位前锋签署了一份新合同，将他的未来承诺给蓝军，至少到2034年为止，然后作为哈维·阿隆索首发阵容的一部分出现在斯坦福桥球场，这是我们自国际比赛日以来的第一场比赛，对阵伯恩茅斯。帕尔默和他的蓝军队友立即恢复了状态，我们的 10 号球员在第二分钟助攻乔丹·亨德森首开纪录，随后摩根·罗杰斯在比赛重新开始后让我们两分领先。下半场若昂·佩德罗梅开二度，亨德森梅开二度，帮助我们以 5-1 击败樱桃队，这是我们近一个月来的首个主场比赛。 “这是一场对阵强队的伟大胜利，”帕尔默说道。 “我们知道这会很困难，但我们打得很好。 “这是美好的一天，尤其是关键球员回来了。几乎全队都回来了，这很好，我觉得这对我们接下来的比赛来说是一个良好的开端。”帕尔默也参与了亨德森的第二个进球，他的冲刺造成犯规，然后这位老将中场将一脚精准的任意球打入球门上角，他透露这一动作是在训练场上直接完成的。 “我们刚刚在训练中一直在努力，当谈到这个问题时，我们正在考虑该怎么做，”科尔透露。 “但我只是对他说：‘我们已经在努力了’。”他在训练中做得很好，所以在射门之前，我说：“当你把球放在上角时，我们要跑向哪个角旗？”。 “然后我们选择了一面角旗，然后他把它放在顶角，然后我们跑到那里。所以这很有趣。这是一个很好的进球，也是美好的一天。” 5-1 的胜利感觉像是庆祝帕尔默当天早些时候宣布的新合同的完美方式，这位 24 岁的球员渴望继续展示切尔西对他的信心。当被问及签署合同时，帕尔默说：“感觉很好。” “感谢俱乐部对我的信任，我必须继续回报他们。 “我只是努力工作并尽力做到最好，仅此而已。我感觉回到了以前的状态，现在才赛季初期，所以继续前进吧。 “对于主教练来说，现在还为时尚早，他仍在努力传达他的想法，但我们已经开始适应，特别是本周我们一直在研究想法和类似的东西，所以这很好。”

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Premier League trip, derby day and Academy action

news.body_en: What to look out for at Chelsea from Monday 12 October to Sunday 18 October, with away days, a London derby at Stamford Bridge and a busy week for our Academy sides. The Blues return to domestic action with fixtures across the men’s, women’s and Academy teams, while Chelsea supporters can also look forward to exclusive interviews, two pre-match press conferences and updates on our internationals. Here is your day-by-day guide to the week ahead. We begin the week by looking back on the men’s 5-1 Premier League victory over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge. Match reaction will continue on the Chelsea Official App and website with interviews featuring Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro and Moises Caicedo. There will also be the latest from Cobham as Xabi Alonso’s squad turns its attention to Saturday’s trip to Everton, plus updates on Chelsea Women players who have been representing their countries during the international period. There is a double helping of Academy action on Tuesday. Chelsea Under-18s travel to Bearwood Park to face Reading in the Under-18 Premier League, with kick-off at 2pm. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live in our Reading vs Chelsea Under-18s Match Centre. Later in the day, the Cobham Next Gen continue their EFL Trophy campaign with their own away trip to Reading. The group-stage fixture kicks off at 7pm, with team news, updates and reaction available across Chelsea’s official channels in our Reading vs Cobham Next Gen Match Centre. We will hear from Moises Caicedo as the midfielder reflects on his first three years as a Blue, describes how he can still get better, and underlines what targets he has in his sights. Our coverage will also include any further news and reaction involving Chelsea Women players on international duty, alongside the latest from the men’s and women’s squads at Cobham. Our exclusive documentary I Am Estevao charts the unique journey of Estevao Willian from the city of Franca in south-east Brazil, through the Santos and Palmeiras youth systems, to arriving in London and that incredible goal against Barcelona. The full documentary is released on CFC+ on Thursday. Attention then turns firmly to the weekend fixtures. We will bring you the latest training and team news as the men prepare to travel to Everton and Chelsea Women build towards a London derby with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. We will hear from both Chelsea head coaches ahead of their weekend matches. Xabi Alonso will preview the men’s Premier League trip to Everton in his pre-match press conference, while Sonia Bompastor will speak to the media before Chelsea Women host Tottenham at Stamford Bridge. Both press conferences will be shown live on the Chelsea Official App and website. There is also Friday-night action for Cobham Next Gen, who travel to Stoke City in the Premier League 2. Kick-off is at 7pm and the game will be shown live for CFC+ subscribers in the Stoke City vs Cobham Next Gen Match Centre. Saturday begins with the latest from Maika Hamano, who will feature in an exclusive interview ahead of Chelsea Women’s London derby the following day. On the pitch, Chelsea Under-18s are away again as they face West Bromwich Albion in the Under-18 Premier League at the Fitlife Foods Performance Centre. Kick-off is at midday live for CFC+ subscribers in our West Bromwich Albion vs Chelsea Under-18s Match Centre. Half-an-hour later, the men’s team return to Premier League action at Everton. The game at Hill Dickinson Stadium kicks off at 12.30pm. Supporters can follow the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and live audio commentary in the Everton vs Chelsea Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, followed by highlights at 4.30pm. The week concludes with a London derby at Stamford Bridge as Chelsea Women host Tottenham Hotspur in the Women’s Super League. The match kicks off at midday. We will have all the build-up, team news and match action in the Chelsea Women vs Tottenham Hotspur Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, followed by a report, highlights and reaction from Bompastor and her players. Tickets for that match on Sunday are on sale now!
